record.body:
## Problem

canon and affidavit are separate repos with git-URL dependencies, old names, and three stores.

## Approach

Squash-import as orchestra.canon and orchestra.tuner, apply the rename map, add canon merge, build one .canon/ store, merge docs, add tests/test_names.py.

## Exit criteria

Full suite passes, canon validate is clean on the merged store, orchestra handoff renders, tests/test_names.py passes.

payload.title: Move canon and affidavit into orchestra

record.subject: monorepo-move
